description: Adapter settings. Wires one convenience: mirroring each session's final reply to a shared location so reports need less manual relaying. It is a convenience, not a control — its absence means UNKNOWN, never that a task did not happen. See .claude/README.md and .claude/hooks/save_agent_reply.py. The push guard is deliberately not here: it lives in .githooks/pre-push, because git invokes that after resolving refspecs while a command hook can only parse shell text. The guard's own header and tests document the bypasses and limits.
